$note: 遷移宮（2026-10-12）：天相.遷移。《深造講義》下篇 宮垣論 遷移宮 p.496–515。客死異鄉、異鄉染病、官非、冤獄、被盜、意外一類斷語不用；天月、天刑、龍池鳳閣等引擎冇嘅星不用；要睇廟陷嘅條文暫不用。

rules.text: 天相在遷移宮，一般吉利，你在外容易接近有地位的人而得利。
rules.en: With Tian Xiang in your Travel Palace, things generally go well: away from home you come close to people of standing, and gain by it.

rules.text: 天相見天魁天鉞，你在外受人提拔；只是宜與人合作或做副手，不宜出鋒頭。
rules.en: Tian Xiang with Tian Kui or Tian Yue: people away from home lift you up, though partnering or playing second fiddle suits you better than the limelight.

rules.text: 天相對著武曲破軍，遷移對你較為不利。
rules.en: Tian Xiang facing Wu Qu–Po Jun makes moving away less favourable for you.

rules.text: 天相對著廉貞破軍，你在外地一般較孤立，遷移不算有利。
rules.en: Tian Xiang facing Lian Zhen–Po Jun: you tend to stand alone away from home, so moving is not really in your favour.

rules.text: 命宮的紫微化權，你以離開出生地發展為宜。
rules.en: Zi Wei in Authority in your Life Palace: developing away from your birthplace suits you.

source.quote: 则以离开出生地发展为宜

rules.text: 天相被〔吉星〕相夾，你在外人緣好，容易得人好感。
rules.en: Tian Xiang is flanked by 〔helper stars〕: you are well liked away from home and win people over easily.

rules.text: 天相被〔煞星〕相夾，你在外容易孤立，少人照應。
rules.en: Tian Xiang is flanked by 〔harsh stars〕: away from home you can end up isolated, with few to look out for you.
